scope: Repository review plus bounded tests against disposable local PostgreSQL; other dynamic application tests remain incomplete

findings.title: Local ledger runtime identity owns schema protection boundary
findings.confidence: High for local bootstrap; AWS role setup unknown
findings.remediationNote: All six money schemas now migrate through a separate svc_migrator one-shot task before rollout; normal startup migration is disabled. Disposable PostGIS verified repeat migrations, ownership/grants, runtime DDL and role-escalation denials, atomic ledger posting, and narrowly scoped DELETE grants. AWS role provisioning, task/secret/IAM/KMS/network configuration, table-level SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE minimization, and staging execution remain unverified.
findings.scopeQualifier: Local bootstrap template only; deployed AWS grants require manual verification

findings.title: Space APIs are absent from gateway route map
findings.remediationStatus: Fixed but Unverified (informational integration gap; not a vulnerability)
findings.remediationNote: Gateway read routes use optional auth; all other Space routes/methods require auth. Route unit tests and TypeScript checks pass; live gateway-to-Go verification remains pending.
findings.scopeQualifier: Source integration gap; gateway runtime not available for live confirmation

findings.title: Shared runtime security group allows HTTPS egress to any IPv4 host
findings.confidence: High for checked-in Terraform; deployed state not verified
findings.remediationNote: Terraform now defaults public HTTPS egress to deny and allows only explicit validated IPv4 CIDRs. Static regression and Terraform validate pass; AWS plan/state and external provider connectivity remain unverified.

findings.title: Provider amount mismatch bypassed payment-intent failure transition
findings.confidence: High; reproduced against disposable PostGIS with a local fake provider
findings.remediationNote: A signed underpaid-charge webhook entered finance review while its pending intent remained pending. Invalid provider fees remain quarantined; amount mismatches now reach transactional state handling. The intent becomes failed, and a mismatched late charge on a cancelled intent remains cancelled and uncredited. Focused fake-provider PostGIS regressions passed. Apple/Google fixture tests and production-like provider integrations remain unverified.
findings.scopeQualifier: Locally verified with synthetic data and fake provider only

findings.title: Concurrent same-key ad-balance withdrawal retries could falsely fail
findings.confidence: High; reproduced with 16 parallel synthetic HTTP requests against disposable PostGIS
findings.remediationNote: Withdrawal reservation now rechecks the user/idempotency key inside the account-locked transaction. A 16-request test passed normally and under Go race detection, with one withdrawal, one ledger debit, one fake payout and a consistent replay ID. Different-key concurrency, multi-instance deployment and real wallet/provider effects remain unverified.
findings.scopeQualifier: Single local process, synthetic PostGIS and fake downstream wallet adapter

findings.title: Production admin allowlist is an unapplied operator prerequisite
findings.remediationStatus: False Positive as a vulnerability; operator prerequisite remains
findings.scopeQualifier: Operational prerequisite; fail-closed behavior observed in source, not a vulnerability

limitations: No full backend stack was started; gateway tests used in-process fake upstreams, and payment tests used a disposable database plus fake provider.
Gitleaks selected-tree scan reviewed 42 candidates; apps, Go, and Git history remain unscanned.
